name: evenhand
description: Self-hostable hackathon submission and judging portal whose rankings come with receipts.

scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml stop db
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:up && npm run db:reset -w @evenhand/api
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run build:engine && concurrently -k -n engine,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @evenhand/judging-engine" "npm run dev -w @evenhand/api" "npm run dev -w @evenhand/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:engine && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:engine && npm run db:up && npm run test:e2e -w @evenhand/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.gen:api: npm run openapi -w @evenhand/api && openapi-typescript src/api/openapi.json -o src/web/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
